paraphrase: The real-valued schedule whose stage n begins at time 1 - (1/2)^n is strictly increasing, every stage begins before time 1, the stage times converge to the endpoint time 1, each stage lasts (1/2)^(n+1) (the gap to the next stage time), these durations sum to 1, and reading each moment of the omega-plus-one supertask order at its clock time is an order embedding of that order into the real line. This is a mathematical model of infinitely many stages in a finite duration, not a claim that such a schedule is physically executable or that any output is attained at the endpoint.
